duplicate_entries.title: Duplicate configuration entries
duplicate_entries.description: MQTT connection state has {count} duplicate configuration entries. They were created by discovery after the Home Assistant 2026.8 update changed device identifiers. Fixing this removes the extra entries and keeps one per device; the connection sensors that remain are already linked to the correct devices, and nothing else is changed. To see the exact list first, run the action "MQTT connection state: Remove duplicate config entries" with dry run enabled.

confirm.title: Remove duplicate configuration entries
confirm.description: Click Submit to remove the duplicate entries this integration created after the Home Assistant 2026.8 update. One entry per device is kept.
